meta.retraction_372_discharged: The commit-7d87dff7 run measured its skiplist arm against a strawman Node embedding all 16 tower pointers statically (~146.7 B/entry); that density figure and the derived 11.1x headline were retracted (#372). Density was re-measured first with the fair variable-height node (8 B key ptr + height*8 B tower, E[height]=4/3). The wall-clock cells are now re-measured against that same fair baseline too (run 33398474866, #382 item 5), and every ratio fell: sequential scan from a published ~10x to 3.331x [3.198, 3.486], point lookup to 1.457x [1.444, 1.470]. Nothing here is pending.
